0x038b8798 Specifies shadows for boxes, or inset shadows/glows.  The shadow shape will match the border box for the panel,so use border-radius to affect rounding.  Syntax takes optional shape 'inset', 'fill', or 'hollow', then color, horizontal offset pixels, vertical offset pixels, blur radius pixels, and spread distance in pixels. Inset means the shadow is an inner shadow/glow, fill is a a shadow behind the entire box, hollow means clipping it to outside the border area only (before offset). A negative blur radius will give a hard-edged look to the shadow, effectively a rounded outline of the same size as the blur.<br><br><b>Examples:</b><pre>box-shadow: #ffffff80 4px 4px 8px 0px; // outer, filled\nbox-shadow: hollow #ffffff80 4px 4px 8px 0px; // outer, hollow\nbox-shadow: inset #333333b0 0px 0px 8px 12px; // inner</pre>
